tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and is not disabled for any environment. Development and testing use self-signed certificates, with verification left on, instead of turning verification off. Connections use HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext HTTP exception, because certificate management is now in place.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
